name: motion-lab
title: Motion Lab
description: Zero-dependency interactive UI motion studies (12) and tactile UI components (8) ready to use as a library, Agent Skill, or MCP server with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Antigravity.
principles: Use asymmetric open/close durations (e.g., 250ms open / 150ms close) so UI feels snappy yet never abrupt.
Default to architectural smooth-out cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); reserve bounce/pop overshoot strictly for small tactile feedback.
Always support mid-flight interruption by transitioning CSS properties or clearing pending timers on re-trigger.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion: reduce on both CSS transitions/animations and JS pointer/timer effects.
Use tabular-nums (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) on animated counters, timers, temperatures, and percentages to prevent layout jitter.

durations.name: --duration-micro
durations.role: Tiny stroke delay or hover press

durations.name: --duration-fast
durations.role: Primary UI open, tabs, accordion, view slide

easings.name: Smooth Out (Primary)
easings.use: Default architectural deceleration for surfaces, tabs, dialogs, accordions

easings.name: Bounce Pop
easings.use: Subtle tactile spring for segmented pills, dials, badges, and drum digits

easings.name: Strong Spring Return
easings.use: Lively elastic return for magnetic hover stacks

easings.name: Ease In-Out
easings.use: Symmetric ambient loops and continuous background fades

easings.name: Sharp Ease Out
easings.use: Fast utilitarian entrances where zero overshoot is desired

motions.title: Adaptive Card Resize
motions.tagline: Smooth width and height continuity when a surface toggles density.
motions.notes: Uses a decelerating smooth-out curve so layout changes feel responsive immediately on click and settle cleanly without bounce.

motions.title: Origin-Aware Action Menu
motions.tagline: Anchored popover growing from its trigger with asymmetric open and close timings.
motions.notes: Transform origin locks to top-center so the surface expands from its button; closing is 100ms faster with softer scale (0.99) to stay out of the user's way.

motions.title: Focal Scale Dialog
motions.tagline: Centered confirmation dialog pairing subtle 0.96 scale with a soft backdrop veil.
motions.notes: Starting at 0.96 instead of 0.8 keeps focal modals crisp and architectural rather than cartoonish.

motions.title: Measured Sliding Tabs
motions.tagline: Segmented control whose active pill measures width and offset for fluid tracking.
motions.notes: Measures offsetLeft and offsetWidth of the target button on click and on ResizeObserver, keeping transform and width synchronized.

motions.title: Grid-Row Accordion
motions.tagline: Intrinsic height disclosure driven by CSS grid-template-rows with synced chevron flip.
motions.notes: Animates grid-template-rows from 0fr to 1fr without hardcoded max-height hacks, preserving exact content height.

motions.title: Directional View Slide
motions.tagline: Forward and backward drill-down view swap with directional offset and cross-blur.
motions.notes: Short spatial displacement paired with mild blur communicates hierarchy direction without causing motion fatigue.

motions.title: Stacked Notification Banners
motions.tagline: Three-deep notification deck that rises in, recedes with depth blur, and fans on hover or tap.
motions.triggers: Click Push / Hover or Tap spread
motions.notes: Receding cards scale down by 6% per layer with progressive opacity and blur, then unfold cleanly into a full list on hover or mobile tap.

motions.title: Segmented Validation Shake
motions.tagline: Tactile horizontal rejection shake on invalid input with automatic neutral recovery.
motions.notes: Decaying horizontal oscillations mimic physical rejection while automatically clearing transient error highlights once acknowledged.

motions.title: Composed Success Check
motions.tagline: Multi-track celebration combining fade, rotate, vertical bounce, de-blur, and SVG stroke draw.
motions.notes: Delaying the SVG checkmark stroke by 80ms lets the circular badge establish presence before the tick draws itself.

motions.title: Spring Heart & Particle Burst
motions.tagline: Overshoot spring pop paired with a nine-particle radial burst on positive toggle.
motions.notes: Asymmetry applies to micro-feedback too: liking celebrates with particles and overshoot while unliking stays quiet and immediate.

motions.title: 3D Drum Counter
motions.tagline: Selective digit-roll counter where only changed digits animate with blur and stagger.
motions.notes: Direction follows value sign (+ rises from below, - drops from above) and tabular numerals prevent horizontal layout jitter.

motions.title: Magnetic Avatar Wave & 3D Tilt
motions.tagline: Distance-falloff hover lift with bouncy return paired with pointer-tracked 3D card tilt.
motions.notes: Neighbor displacement decays exponentially (0.45^distance) on hover-in and snaps back with a lively spring curve on mouse leave.

components.title: Pulse Climate Dial

components.triggers: Click − / + · Switch Eco / Comfort / Warm Glow

components.triggers: Switch Live Route / Gate B14 / Boarding

components.title: Tempo Spatial Audio Deck

components.triggers: Play / Pause · Switch Studio / Warm / Spatial

components.title: Chroma Palette Studio
components.tagline: Multi-layer radial mesh gradient studio with crossfading Solstice / Cobalt / Matcha themes, live OKLCH readout, and one-click CSS copy.

components.title: Focus Deep Work Timer
components.tagline: Warm-paper Pomodoro timer with smooth SVG countdown ring, tabular digits, and Rain / Vinyl / Forest ambient chips.
components.triggers: Start / Pause Session · Toggle Ambient Sound Chips

components.title: Forge Edge Deploy Pipeline
components.tagline: Interactive deployment card that cascades through 4 staggered build stages with spring checkmarks and live edge latency status.

components.title: Design Shelf 3D Deck
components.tagline: Tactile Swiss graphic book cover-flow with perspective depth stacking, synced reading progress bar, and spring bookmark toggle.

components.title: Relay Issue Triage Card
